description: Percentage of good parts out of (good + scrap), computed live on the edge over the CURRENT counter values (IMM counters are cumulative_resettable — this is a since-last-reset ratio, not a shift window; windowed truth lives in … Full text: docs/history/kpis/quality-rate.md, description.

calculation.cypher: CASE WHEN (m.part_good + m.part_scrap) = 0 THEN null ELSE round(toFloat(m.part_good) / (m.part_good + m.part_scrap) * 1000) / 10 END
